lines: Our hands linked in front of the ticket gate
The usual bustle, a fresh wind
I should have seen you off brightly
But I could only stare at you, unable to smile
The season when you become an adult
So that it won’t be filled with sad songs
At the end I wanted to tell you something
A word to replace goodbye
I was searching for it
The role of guiding your hand
I thought it was my mission
But now I understand
If it’s us, already
The days we’ve piled together
Will lead the way
The time when you become an adult
As the years pile up, I too am changing
If there were a song like this there
We would always stay connected
No matter when
A sudden ringing bell bursts out
I, impatient, loosen my grip
You drift away
I call out to you frantically
And hold you tight
Wherever you go
My voice will protect you
Since the day you appeared before me
Everything seemed different
Morning, light, tears, even the singing voice
You gave them all their shine
Feelings I can’t hold back
Ride on this voice
Let them reach your distant town
If, for example,
It were a song like this
No matter where we are
We can stay connected
